scope: Five highest-yield blocks and strongest within-chunk similarity candidates; not an exhaustive semantic duplicate or source-fidelity certification.

candidate_review.selection: All within-chunk pairs with cached normalized GTE cosine >= 0.985; threshold ranks review candidates only and never determines equivalence.
candidate_review.decision: Retain distinct or uncertain propositions, except explicit source-quality exclusions above.
observations: Protected-group lists enumerate different beneficiaries; race, national origin, citizenship, immigration status, sex, gender identity, income and other named categories are not interchangeable.
Operational, logistical and intelligence support in Yemen are different mechanisms, not synonyms.
Reducing weapon counts and reducing delivery systems are distinct commitments even with the same deterrence condition.
Having the means and having the responsibility to shape globalization distinguish capability from obligation.
Responsive, open and effective governments name different qualities.
Maintaining current Venezuelan oil output and returning to pre-2015 output name different quantities/time baselines.
Worker versus company export opportunities name different beneficiaries.
Accessible versus beneficial technologies distinguish access from benefit.
Preventing, detecting and ending cancer are different objectives.
Survivor services versus support, broader statements versus qualified examples, and overlapping rhetorical wording do not establish safe bidirectional equivalence; uncertain pairs remain separate.
